name: Electronic Manufacturing Clusters (EMC) Scheme: Common Facility Centres/ Brownfield Electronics Manufacturing Clusters
benefit:
> **Financial Assistance:**

1. **For Brownfield EMCs:**

  - Financial assistance up to 75% of the project cost.
  - Maximum limit of ₹50,00,00,000/-.

1.  **Government grant in:** 

  - Processing area: up to 50% of the project cost
  - Non-processing area: up to 20% of project cost

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a legal entity such as an individual, company, society, industry association, financial institution, research and development (R&D) institution, or government agency. 1. The applicant should form a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) for implementation. 1. The applicant should submit a preliminary application along with a feasibility study and project details. 1. The applicant should ensure that the committed investment is at least 4 times the assistance sought. 1. The applicant should ensure that at least 75% of the investment is in electronics manufacturing units. 1. The applicant should propose the upgradation of an existing Electronics Manufacturing Cluster. 1. The applicant should ensure the presence of an existing industrial ecosystem/cluster. 1. The applicant should achieve financial closure before submitting the final application. 1. The applicant should submit a Detailed Project Report (DPR).
